in_marathi.name: Karuna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karuna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karuna is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘kar’, which means ‘to do’. The name is associated with the goddess of compassion, Karunamayi, and represents the qualities of kindness, empathy, and mercy. In Hindu mythology, Karuna is believed to be a manifestation of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, who is also known for her compassionate nature.
